recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13761 unless a future work-group decision changes the Composition.author target set.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 request to add Organization as an allowed reference type for Composition.author, motivated by documents and catalogs where an organization is the recognized author rather than an individual or device.
initial_application: No Composition-source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-13761 was found. The current Composition XML source already included Organization on Composition.author when that source was introduced during the R4B/new-build refactor, and later author-target work retained it.
additional_context: Related Jira searches found FHIR-13745 as a duplicate Composition.author Organization request and FHIR-13362 as an earlier request resolved as previously implemented. Later FHIR-32539 added CareTeam to the same target list without changing the Organization allowance. A linked 2017 Zulip thread supports the same CDA representedOrganization mapping need, while direct FHIR-13761 Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. source/fhir.ini actively includes Composition, and source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml lists http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Organization in the Composition.author targetProfile list.
